summary: A young teen tells his parent that a bigger campaign would take away family time.
realLife: California Governor Gavin Newsom said on CNN that his family would decide whether he runs for president. His son Romeo texted him asking whether he was running after a headline suggested he had decided, and told him he needed to spend more time with the children.
gates: The player has a child at home.
Press reports the player may seek a higher office.
weights: Closeness of the tie to the child.
inGame: A young child at home and a job left to run, with the household reacting when the player files.

turns.what: The child says to go for it and is excited by the campaign.
turns.pulledBy: Older child, a boy or girl who enjoys the public side.
turns.writesBack: A positive tie bump; child may volunteer.

turns.what: The child shrugs and returns to homework, and the parent decides alone.
The parent promises set family nights and the child holds them to it.
turns.writesBack: A promise to the child tracked against hours worked.
